global_summary: A GMC Certified Service technician provides a detailed tutorial on essential vehicle maintenance, focusing on tire care and exhaust system inspection. The video covers GMC's official recommendations for tire rotation intervals, demonstrates practical methods for checking tread depth using both specialized tools and common household items, explains wheel alignment procedures, and shows how to inspect for exhaust damage. Throughout, it emphasizes professional GMC service offerings and safety.
reason: The video is instructional in nature, providing step-by-step maintenance procedures (tutorial theme). The automotive technician expertise dominates due to hands-on demonstrations of tire rotation, tread inspection, alignment, and exhaust checks. Safety inspector weight is significant because of emphasis on tread depth for safety and road hazard awareness. Brand educator weight reflects consistent promotion of GMC Certified Service and official recommendations. Visual communicator weight supports the clear comparative visuals (good vs. bad tread, split-screen comparisons) that enhance tutorial clarity.
